findings.text: Move control groups source and destination area descriptors with old range start and exclusive end plus new range start and caller supplied byte length, together with flags indicating whether reverse mapping locks are required and whether the operation concerns a bootstrap stack relocation.
Initializer helper populates a move control from supplied areas addresses and length, deriving the exclusive old end as the sum of old start and length while copying the remaining inputs unchanged.

Reclaim mask fact combines reclaim related allocation modifiers covering reclaim permission, high memory, input output, filesystem, warning suppression, retry with possible failure, mandatory success, no retry, memory allocation allowance and its negation, and lock dependency suppression.
Boot mask fact equals the full allocation bits with reclaim, input output and filesystem bits removed.
Constraint mask fact combines placement constraints for hard wall enforcement and single node restriction.
Slab bug mask fact combines thirty two bit direct memory access, high memory, and all bits outside the defined allocation bits.
Conditional one shot warning reports truth of its condition, emitting a warning at most once per call site and suppressing emission when the supplied allocation flags request no warning.
Entirely mapped sentinel value is 0x800000 and folio pages mapped is one less than that sentinel.
Node filter flag uses low bit value 0x0001u to mean disallowed nodes.
File mapping helper delegates to the filesystem mapping hook and returns success on no error, otherwise installs dummy area operations to block further hooks and propagates the error.
Close helper invokes the configured close hook when present exactly once, then installs dummy operations so later hooks cannot run, leaving areas without a close hook unchanged.
Anonymous structure reference acquisition increments its reference count.
Nonblocking write acquisition attempts the root read write semaphore and reports whether the lock was obtained without sleeping.
Area operation enumeration distinguishes split, merge of unfaulted ranges, remap, and fork cases.
Folio batch spare type is a distinct bitwise integer used for dirty and merge handling modifiers.

Five modifier bits use low positions zero through four to convey respect for hardware dirty, respect for soft dirty, respect for writability, merging of writability, and merging of young with dirty state.
Isolated throttle wakeup signals the node reclaim wait queue for isolated throttling only when waiters are present.
Consecutive page marking helper marks the stated number of pages starting at the given page as reference counted by advancing frame by frame.
Maximum reclaim retry count is sixteen.

Compaction control aggregates per order free lists and a migrate list with isolated counts, search bases for free and migrate scans plus a fast linear start, zone pointer, scan totals, fast search failure and order hints, allocation parameters for mask order type flags and highest zone, migration mode, and boolean modifiers for skip hints suitability whole zone contention forward progress and contiguous allocation.

Capture control groups a zone pointer, migration type, original allocation order, and resulting page, where order is preserved separately from any promoted compaction order so post allocation initialization stays consistent.

Walk end address helper uses a single page fast path of one page size past current address, otherwise converts page offset span into an address from area start using anon or file start bases, clamping to area end when below start above end or wrapped.
Lock eligibility excludes areas with special flags, droppable state, direct access or hugetlb character, and the gate area of the current address space, allowing all others.
Remote lock drain is an empty operation taking a processor identifier and performing no action in this configuration.
Node reclaim mode constant is zero in this configuration, indicating disabled node reclaim.
Disabled node reclaim helper always reports zero reclaimed and best node lookup always reports no node.
Enablement test reports true when any of zone, write, or unmap reclaim bits are set in the mode value.
Hardware poison filter type describes a function from a page to an integer decision.
Hardware poison magic value is 0x48575053U corresponding to tag HWPS.
Poisoned folio unmapping stub always reports busy failure without acting, regardless of folio frame or kill flag.
Dirty flush helper for reverse unmapping is an empty operation.
Migration target control groups preferred node identifier, node mask pointer, allocation mask, and migration reason.

Internal page pin flags occupy bits sixteen through twenty two meaning mark accessed, previous input output retry, remote task address space, pin with special release, fast only without slow fallback, unlockable mapping lock, and populate style area checks, with the combined internal mask being the union of all seven.
Enabled shrinker name helper formats a persistent name under kernel allocation and reports out of memory on failure, while its paired free helper releases the name and clears the pointer.
Constant aware free releases the pointer only when outside kernel read only data, otherwise doing nothing.
Disabled debug builds make shrinker add and name allocation report success without action, make name free and entry removal empty, and make detach set identifier to negative one and return no entry.
Page acceptance helper is an empty operation.
Input output remap preparation adjusts frame and protection for decryption, delegates to generic remap preparation, and on success marks the action as frame remap without performing mapping itself.

Remap preparation validates that the requested range lies inside the area descriptor, derives copy on write offset with full coverage requirement and records frame as offset in that case, then applies remap flags.
Conditional reverse mapping unlock releases the file mapping write lock and clears the hide flag only when hiding was requested, asserting the area is not anonymous.

Notifying young clear with flush combines the local page table young clear and flush over the batch with a notifier young clear over the same byte span, returning whether either observed young, for both batched entries and single huge middle level entries.
Notifying young test and clear without flush likewise combines local test and clear with notifier clear over the same span and reports the union, for batched entries and huge middle level entries.
Without notifier support the four notifying names alias directly to their plain counterparts with identical behaviour.
Huge middle level young clear requires huge alignment, atomically tests and clears young, and flushes the translation cache over the huge span only when young was observed.
Maximum map count accessor returns the current control value through a single atomic read.
Swap entry preparation links the address space into the global list under the list lock using double checked emptiness so concurrent callers add at most once.
Try lock eligibility forbids spinning try lock from nonmaskable or hard interrupt context on realtime builds and from nonmaskable context on uniprocessor builds, allowing all other contexts.
File reverse mapping tree supports insertion, ordered insertion after a predecessor with maintenance of subtree maxima along the descent and augmented rebalancing, and removal keyed by area offsets.
File tree iteration finds the first overlapping area for an offset interval and steps to successive overlapping areas within the same bounds.

Anonymous reverse mapping uses interval trees keyed by anon start and last offsets derived from the chain area, with insertion caching those bounds for debug verification and removal deleting by chain.
Anonymous tree iteration finds first and successive chains overlapping an offset interval, while verification warns when cached start or last bounds diverge from current derivation.

Generic input output remap rejects unavailable slab, empty size, and address wrap, page aligns the request, allocates a virtual area in the ioremap range, records the physical base, maps the span, and on mapping failure releases the area, otherwise returning the virtual base plus original offset.
No memory management unit build treats virtual area release as an unrecoverable fault.
Ioremap range mapping requires an existing ioremap marked area exactly matching the requested span, warning and failing on mismatch, otherwise delegating to the generic virtual mapping range.
Virtual mapping range installs non executable mappings without flush, then flushes processor caches and applies sanitizer accounting for the same span, propagating any failure.

No flush range installer walks kernel top level entries over non empty spans, may sleep for table allocation and translation shootdown, accumulates a synchronization mask across levels, and performs a single kernel mapping synchronization when required.
